summary: Hard-cut one production Liepin cards browser operation behind an authenticated, journaled Source Execution Port.
rationale: The cards operation must move atomically across Runtime Control acceptance and outbox ownership, a supervised sidecar process, durable command history, content-addressed artifacts, reconciliation, candidate truth ingestion, and Checkpoint v2. Splitting the new route from deletion would leave a direct production browser bypass or two competing correctness authorities.
deletion_targets: main-process direct cards search routes to WTSCLI and Chrome
the process-global OpenCLI search lock as correctness authority
verify-session Source Port simulations not consumed by a production primitive
high-level OpenCLI extension and Python helper search commands that bypass the cards Source Execution Port
line_count_rationale: These existing oversized ownership modules receive only the narrow wiring or transactional changes required by the vertical hard cut. Splitting stable browser, runtime, or Runtime Control storage modules is a separate refactor outside this operation migration.
verification: uv run --group dev python -m pytest -q -p no:tach tests/test_liepin_cards_source_operation.py tests/test_source_port_command_journal.py tests/test_runtime_control_source_operations.py tests/test_runtime_control_source_reconciliation.py tests/test_source_port_history_contract.py tests/test_source_port_authenticated_history_frames.py
uv run --group dev ruff check src tests experiments tools
uv run --group dev ty check src tests tools
uv run --group dev python tools/check_privacy_gate.py --base origin/main
uv run --group dev python tools/check_agent_safety_gate.py --base origin/main
uv run --group dev python tools/check_ai_bad_smells.py --base origin/main
uv run --group dev python tools/check_pr_governance.py --base origin/main
risks: A transport timeout after browser dispatch must reconcile history instead of repeating the browser effect.
A stale executor, profile generation, dispatch epoch, or sidecar generation must not commit a late observation.
Terminal and partial payloads must remain outside the compact command journal and bind through immutable artifact references.
Candidate truth and the operation main commit reference must advance in the same SQLite transaction as the Checkpoint v2 pointer.
The hard cut must not move details, continuation, cleanup, or verify-session into this sidecar operation.
